name: LTX-2.3 Video
description: Lightricks LTX-2.3 distilled text-to-video (with audio). One-click install bootstraps uv, fetches the official LTX-2 repo, creates a CUDA venv (no xformers; SDPA fallback works on consumer Blackwell), and installs the JSON API server. Weights are NOT downloaded — point it at the folder holding the LTX-2.3 distilled + spatial-upscaler .safetensors and a gemma-3-* text-encoder dir (add it under Settings → Model Folders, e.g. E:\ckpts). Exposes POST /generate {"prompt":"..."} → an mp4. Auto-picks the GPU with the most free VRAM.
